All done! I've created `src/invoices.js` with the `createInvoice` function and added comprehensive tests.

**Changes made:**
- Added three new error codes to `src/errors.js`: `DATE_INVALID`, `NO_LINES`, and `QTY_INVALID`
- Created `src/invoices.js` with `createInvoice({ customerId, issueDate, lines })` that validates all inputs, looks up the customer and products, and enriches line items with catalogue data
- Created `test/invoices.test.js` with 8 tests covering happy paths and all error conditions

The function correctly validates dates by checking both format and actual validity (rejects Feb 30, month 13, etc.), and all 22 tests pass.
